sentences.text: Shri Raj Kumar Swarnkar - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Viraj Godha - Pl for the respondent/State.
ORDER Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is first application filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short "BNSS"), for grant of bail to the applicant/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.294/2024 dated - 07.05.2024 registered at Police Station -Biora, District - Rajgarh (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 406, 409, 420 and 120-B of the IPC.
2. Prosecution story in brief is that Rajendra Kumar Sahu, father of complainant Rahul Sahu has a shop at Galla Mandi, Biaora.
Gajendra Singh is registered owner of truck bearing registration No.RJ-11-GC-4732 and present applicant/accused Munnesh Singh is driver of aforesaid truck.

On 30.04.2024, the complainant had loaded 305 quintals of masoor worth of Rs.18,18,098/- on the aforesaid truck from the shop of his father at Biaora, which was to be delivered to Bake Bihari Pulses Mill, Delhi and the present NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:27138 2 MCRC-38301-2024 applicant alongwith the loaded truck proceeded towards Delhi from Biaora, but till the stipulated time, the present applicant had not delivered masoor to the consignee.

Therefore,
on 07.05.2024, the matter was reported by the complainant against the present applicant.

During investigation, it was revealed that the present applicant Munnesh and co-accused person Manoj Munesh Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149473979/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 Singh, Ramu, Ramkesh and Gajendra Singh entered into criminal conspiracy and had entered into an agreement to illegally sell the masoor in the way.
On 02.05.2024, the present applicant and co-accused persons unloaded the truck at Gohad, Dist.- Bhind and Masoor was stored in a vacant house.
Thereafter, co-accused Manoj Singh sold the Masoor to Manoj Jain and Sunil Pahadia.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant/accused submits that the applicant has not committed the offence and has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is further submitted that he was driving the aforesaid truck as per the direction given by the truck owner.
When he reached Morena, he handed over the loaded truck to the truck owner, thereafter he had no knowledge about the incident.
It is also submitted that truck owner and other co-accused persons are liable for the offence.
Earlier, the FIR was lodged against the applicant only u/S 406 of IPC, but during investigation other offences u/S 409, 420 and 120B of IPC were added.
It is submitted that the applicant is in custody since 05.07.2024..
After completion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
Trial will take considerable long time for its disposal.
No further custodial interrogation is required, therefore, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.

4. On other hand, learned counsel for the State/non-applicant has NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-IND:27138 3 MCRC-38301-2024 opposed the prayer of the applicant and submits that the present applicant is the main accused of the incident.
Co-accused persons Ramkesh and Gajendra are still absconded.
After the incident, the present applicant was also absconded and he was arrested after several attempts in Delhi.
If he is granted bail, it cannot be denied that the applicant may flee again.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant is not entitled for bail.

5. Having considered the rival contentions of the learned counsels for the parties, perused the case diary, also looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, it appears that the applicant is main accused of the incident coupled with the fact that two accused are still absconded, therefore,
this Court is of considered view that this is not fit case to grant bail to the applicant.

Resultantly,
application for bail is rejected.

(PRAKASH CHANDRA GUPTA) JUDGE Shruti Munesh Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149473979/
